name: walk_stairs_up
text: A person steadily walks forward up stairs, alternating feet, one foot on each step. Each step is nineteen centimetres high and thirty-eight centimetres deep. Lift the swinging foot clearly above each stair edge, keep the supporting foot planted, and continue climbing at a regular rhythm. Arms swing naturally at the sides.
